result.topic_en: Scattered calculations, written in several orientations, on a second-order differential equation in Q (a Legendre-type equation in x with substitutions such as $p=\chi^{3/2}$), a spherical-trigonometry cosine relation, and three-term recurrence relations among coefficients $a_n$, $b_n$ involving derivatives with respect to a parameter.
result.transcription:
$d\,\kappa(1-\kappa)\frac{\partial Q}{\partial \kappa} = Q\,\kappa\, d\kappa$
$d\,s(1-s)\frac{\partial Q}{\partial s} = Q\, ds$
[-$s(1-s)\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial s}$-] $s=\frac{1+x}{2}$
$d\,(1-x^2)\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = Q\, dx$
$(1-x^2)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial x^2} - 8x\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial x} = \chi$
$p = \chi^{\frac{3}{2}}$
$\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} = \frac{3}{2}\chi^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial x^2} = \frac{3}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\chi^{-\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \frac{3}{2}\chi^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial x^2}$

$\cos\alpha = \cos\beta\cos\gamma - \sin\beta\sin\gamma$ [?]
$\cos\beta^2 + \cos\gamma^2 + \cos\alpha^2 + \cos\beta^2\cos\gamma^2 - 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta\cos\gamma - \cos\beta^2\cos\gamma^2$ [?]
$\begin{vmatrix} 1 & \cos\alpha & \cos\beta \\ \cos\alpha & 1 & \cos\gamma \\ \cos\beta & \cos\gamma & 1 \end{vmatrix}$ [?]

$\frac{dp}{d\alpha_{n}}(p - n\alpha - nb\epsilon) + a_n - b_n = p a_{n-1}$ [?]
$\frac{dp}{d\alpha_{n+1}}(p-(n+1)\alpha - \ldots) + a_{n+1} - b_{n+1} = p a_n$ [?]
$\frac{dp}{d a_{-1}} + a_{-1} = \frac{p}{2}(a_0 + a_{-1})$ [?]
$\frac{dp}{d a_{0}} + a_{0} = \frac{p}{2}(a_1 + a_{-1})$ [?]
$\chi_1^2 + 2\frac{\alpha}{\beta}\rho\chi_1 = 1$ [?]
$\chi_1' = -\frac{\alpha}{\beta} + \frac{\sqrt{1+\frac{\alpha^2}{\beta^2}\rho^2}}{\chi_1}$ [?]
$\left(1+\frac{\alpha^2}{\beta^2}\rho^2\right)\chi_1' = -\frac{\alpha}{\beta} + \frac{\alpha}{\beta}\rho\chi_1$ [?]
$\chi^2 + 2\frac{\alpha}{\beta}\rho\chi = 1$ [?]
$\frac{d\rho}{d\chi_n} = \frac{d\rho}{d\chi_{n-1}} + \ldots$ [?]
$a_{n+1} = \ldots$ [?]

methods.what: Change of variable s=(1+x)/2 turning a hypergeometric-type equation into a Legendre-type equation
Substitution p = χ^{3/2} with first and second derivatives
Gram determinant of direction cosines (spherical trigonometry)
Three-term recurrence/differential relations between coefficients a_n, b_n
methods.quote: $\frac{dp}{d\alpha_{n}}(p - n\alpha - nb\epsilon) + a_n - b_n = p a_{n-1}$

methods.what: Quadratic relation for χ and its derivative
